title: Sweep
text: One held A3 while L/E sweeps from 20 to 50,000 km/GeV over 24 s, on the curves measured on ibm_fez. You hear nu-mu (A3) fade into nu-tau (an octave down) at the first atmospheric maximum, beat back and forth through the fast atmospheric wiggles, then nu-e (a fifth up) swell near the solar maximum.
settings: chip ibm_fez (real hardware) / mix 1 / 3 flavours / L/E 20 -> 50,000 km/GeV

title: Chip compare
text: The same A3 + E4 phrase, flying outward from L/E 2,500 km/GeV, played 7 times: exact, aer, fake_fez, fake_torino, fake_brisbane, fake_kyoto, ibm_fez. Same physics every time; what changes is each machine's noise in the measured curves.
settings: every 3.4 s: exact / aer / fake_fez / fake_torino / fake_brisbane / fake_kyoto / ibm_fez / flight 0.18 dec/s

title: Pad
text: Am, F, C, G with slow attacks. Every chord starts at L/E 300 km/GeV and flies outward while held, so each chord drifts from muon-flavoured into tau-flavoured. Curves measured on ibm_fez.
settings: chip ibm_fez (real hardware) / mix 1 / 3 flavours / L/E 300 km/GeV / flight 0.12 dec/s
